onboarding_slide0_description: An integrated, reliable system designed specifically for freight offices and merchants to manage orders, consolidate shipments, and calculate dimensions and currencies with seamless precision.
onboarding_slide0_point1: Centralized management of all commercial operations
onboarding_slide0_point2: Smooth, elegant design that streamlines your workflow
onboarding_slide1_subtitle: From Initial Draft to Final Delivery
onboarding_slide1_description: Record item details, purchase costs, and customer pricing with instant profit and margin calculations for each order under a unique sequential number.
onboarding_slide1_point1: Track order stages (Draft, Confirmed, Prepared, Shipped, Completed)
onboarding_slide1_point2: Precise calculation of profit margins and goods costs
onboarding_slide1_point3: Smart filtering and instant categorization of sales
onboarding_slide2_description: Consolidate multiple customer orders into a single shipment with ease. The system automatically computes volumes and weights for optimal space and freight efficiency.
onboarding_slide2_point1: Accurate volume and weight calculation per package
onboarding_slide2_point2: Effortless recording and matching of net and gross weights
onboarding_slide2_point3: Seamless package merging into a single consolidated cargo
onboarding_slide3_description: Manage container numbers, tracking IDs, shipping lines, and carriers. Monitor cargo movement from origin ports and customs clearance to the final warehouse.
onboarding_slide3_point1: Link container IDs, vessel details, and shipping carriers
onboarding_slide3_point2: Manage authorized agents, drivers, and freight partners
onboarding_slide3_point3: Transparent, real-time stage monitoring for active shipments
onboarding_slide4_description: Maintain your customer directory with contact info and addresses. Monitor purchase history, payments, receivables, and outstanding balances with total privacy.
onboarding_slide4_point1: Accurate financial and receivables ledger for each client
onboarding_slide4_point2: Comprehensive record of past purchases and orders
onboarding_slide4_point3: Quick direct contact and instant invoice sharing
onboarding_slide5_subtitle: Riyal, USD, and CNY in Full Harmony
onboarding_slide5_description: Transact effortlessly in local and international currencies; price in USD, Chinese Yuan, or Saudi Riyal with live exchange rates and error-free conversions.
onboarding_slide5_point1: Support for Saudi Riyal and global trading currencies
onboarding_slide5_point2: Flexible, instant updates for exchange rates and conversion factors
onboarding_slide5_point3: Protect net profit margins against currency fluctuations
onboarding_slide6_title: Complete Security & Privacy Around the Clock
onboarding_slide6_subtitle: Your Data is Stored Safely on Your Device
onboarding_slide6_description: Your business records are yours alone and saved locally with the highest standards of security. The app operates at full capacity offline with quick backup and restore anytime.
onboarding_slide6_point1: Safe local storage of all records without internet connectivity
onboarding_slide6_point2: Uninterrupted data entry and review offline
onboarding_slide6_point3: One-tap backup creation and system restore
onboarding_slide7_subtitle: Your Complete Business Suite is Ready
onboarding_slide7_description: All professional trade and logistics tools are now in your hands. Elevate your operations with precision, clear profits, and sustainable growth with Mosaed.
onboarding_slide7_point1: Modern, rapid interface designed to speed up your daily work
onboarding_slide7_point2: Harmonious coordination of warehouse and order cycles
onboarding_slide7_point3: Total, direct control over every aspect of your enterprise

about_app_subtitle: Your friendly guide to the app and its creator
about_app_overview_desc: A smart, simple app designed specifically for merchants, retail shop owners, and cargo brokers to replace tedious paper ledgers and complex spreadsheets. It helps you manage orders, consolidate and track shipments, and follow customer balances effortlessly—with no technical complexity and zero internet dependency.
about_app_features_section_subtitle: Every part of the app is crafted to save your time and simplify your daily trade
feat_orders_desc: Record customer orders instantly, specify purchase costs and selling prices, and let the app calculate your net profit with zero errors or hassle.
feat_shipments_desc: Bundle multiple orders for different clients into a single carton or container to reduce shipping costs and monitor cargo until final delivery.
feat_customers_desc: Keep complete customer records, track payments and remaining debts, and message or remind them on WhatsApp with a single tap.
feat_currencies_desc: Handle Yemeni Rial, Saudi Riyal, and US Dollars effortlessly, with instant multi-currency conversions based on market rates.
feat_pdf_desc: Generate and share clean, professional invoices and receipts ready for printing or instant sharing with customers via WhatsApp.
feat_offline_desc: All your business data and accounts remain stored securely on your device only—no external servers, no cloud tracking, works anytime.
feat_backup_desc: Save a secure backup file of your database and restore it anytime or transfer it to another device with peace of mind.
about_dev_bio: Software engineer and creator who built this application with great care and passion to empower merchants, retailers, and cargo handlers with seamless, modern tools prioritizing utmost privacy, speed, and simplicity.
about_dev_quote: "The goal is always to make technology a simple, delightful partner that serves you and saves your time, never a burden."
about_dev_message: Welcome! This application was crafted to be your trusted business companion in all your daily operations. We believe that ease of use, robust offline performance, and complete data privacy are what every merchant deserves. Your feedback is always warmly welcomed!
about_dev_share_text: I recommend trying 'Retail & Cargo Assistant' - a great offline app for managing sales, orders, shipments, and customer debts! Developed by: Salah aldain alhajj
